[[File:Kachirho_clan_symbol.png|thumb|right|200px|Emblem of Kachirho clan]]
The '''Kachirho clan''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] clan that founded the city of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] on the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|190|Kachirho}}</ref> Members of the clan during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] included [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]] and [[Merumeru/Legends|Merumeru]] who fought the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]].<ref name="RotS:TVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
